tokens.name: letterbox
tokens.usage: The two 72px letterbox bars only. Pure black so the scene's black (`black`) reads as lit air, not void.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Screen ground of every dark scene.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Raised surface on dark: the active episode row, the secondary button at rest.

tokens.name: smoke
tokens.usage: Inset on dark: thumbnails' matte, inset fields. Only `cream`, `ash` or `yellow` text on it (`fog` fails here).

tokens.name: ash
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `black`, `night` and `smoke` (7.8:1 on black). Nav links at rest, meta, billing filler words.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on `black` and `night` only (5.2:1 / 4.9:1): letterbox labels, row numbers, column headers. Never on `smoke`, never for anything you must read twice.

tokens.name: dust
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `cream` and `cream-deep` (6.2:1 / 5.3:1).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Primary text on dark; ground of the About scene.

tokens.name: cream-deep
tokens.usage: Raised surface on cream.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on `cream` and on `yellow`; the Ink button fill.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Marquee yellow = light or action: the current-page dot, the next-section cue, the one primary button, active states, progress. Never as text on cream.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: ROB-092's voice: Caveat notes and gibberish on dark. 9.9:1 on black; fails on cream (use `red` there). Not used for the sound toggle (it is the yellow waveform).

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Pulp red pigment: the live/record dot, the email underline, red type on cream (5.9:1). On dark, red TYPE uses `red-lit` (raw red is only 2.9:1 on black).

tokens.name: red-lit
tokens.usage: Red type on dark (4.9:1 on black): the CONTACT title, the one loud word on a dark scene. Red as if lit by the scene's lamp.

tokens.name: red-deep
tokens.usage: Deep red shadow: the falloff of a red-lit scene, never a flat fill behind text.

tokens.name: gold-hi
tokens.usage: Marquee gold fill, highlight stop (where the light hits the letters).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Marquee gold fill, mid stop.

tokens.name: gold-lo
tokens.usage: Marquee gold fill, shadow stop (the letters' base, away from the light). 4.2:1 on black, so display sizes only.

tokens.name: light-warm
tokens.usage: Tungsten light: spotlight beams, dust motes, lamp cones. Used as a spill at 8–24% over the ground, never solid.

tokens.name: light-screen
tokens.usage: Cool light emitted by screens and monitors (trailer spill, case-study monitor). 6–16% over the ground.

tokens.name: grade-teal
tokens.usage: The teal half of the teal-and-orange grade, laid into shadows at 20–35% (multiply). Never a fill.

tokens.name: rob-body
tokens.usage: 3D only: ROB-092's 'Main' material. Not a UI colour; UI orange is `orange`.

tokens.name: rob-metal
tokens.usage: 3D only: ROB-092's grey parts.

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Scene ground. Flip with [data-theme].

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, active rows, the subtitle box base.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Inset fills: thumbnails' matte, input fields at rest.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Headlines and body on `bg-base` and `bg-raised`, both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text on `bg-base`, `bg-raised` and `bg-inset`, both themes (≥4.5:1 everywhere).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Micro-labels on `bg-base` and `bg-raised` only: letterbox bars, row numbers, column heads.

tokens.name: text-accent
tokens.usage: Accent type: the next-section cue, the lit dot and superscript of the current nav item, the lit word. Yellow on dark, red on cream.

tokens.name: text-loud
tokens.usage: The rare red: one loud word or title per page (CONTACT), the ROB-092 speaker name.

tokens.name: text-note
tokens.usage: Caveat pencil notes and robot gibberish.

tokens.name: action-fill
tokens.usage: The one primary button per screen: yellow on dark, ink on cream.

tokens.name: action-text
tokens.usage: Label on `action-fill` (13.4:1 / 15.6:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row separators, column rules, frame strokes that are structure not meaning.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Strokes that carry meaning (discipline tag outline, the About cut's edge, focus-adjacent rules) — 3:1 minimum.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, 3px offset, on every interactive element (≥3:1 on every ground).

styles.name: marquee-xl
styles.usage: The name only: hero and end credits. Always uppercase, gold fill + glow.

styles.name: marquee-l
styles.usage: A page title that is the scene's subject (CONTACT).

styles.name: marquee-m
styles.usage: The playing project's title on Projects, in cream (44px when the name is over 12 characters; never wraps).

styles.name: logo
styles.usage: The logotype: ETTORE 800 cream, SERRA 600 #8C8576 (brightens on hover). 14px on mobile. See the Logo component.

styles.name: poster-xl
styles.usage: A project's title on its own scene (case-study hero).

styles.name: poster-l
styles.usage: Section headlines. The About headline runs at 84px (off-scale, documented in scenes.md).

styles.name: poster-m
styles.usage: Block headlines, Fact values, the robot's answer on mobile About.

styles.name: label-s
styles.usage: Bottom-row labels, timecodes, discipline tags, Fact labels. The floor: no Alumni Sans below 13px.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Six years turning ideas into interfaces people remember.
styles.usage: Loglines and the first paragraph of a scene. Max 40ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pausa lives in the macOS menu bar and, when it's time to stop, spins a fortune wheel.
styles.usage: All running text. Max 60ch. Full `text-primary`, never grey-on-grey.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions and card meta in sentence case.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: Robot subtitles, always on an 84% black box.

styles.name: dialogue
styles.sample: Six years. Two as the only developer at INFN.
styles.usage: ROB-092's answers in the About interview (desktop).

styles.name: note
styles.usage: One director's note per screen, max ~6 words. Currently only on the loading page.

styles.name: gibberish
styles.usage: The robot's untranslated voice above a subtitle; screenplay parentheticals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: meter steps, tick marks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label stacks, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row padding, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gutter; between buttons; card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between a headline and its body.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a scene.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop outer margin; scene top padding below the bar.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Between major scene regions.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Rare: the end-credits roll gap.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Top and bottom rows, and the black bars where a page keeps them (desktop). 56px on mobile.

tokens.name: margin-desktop
tokens.usage: Outer margin at 1440, 12 columns.

tokens.name: margin-tablet
tokens.usage: Outer margin at 1024, 8 columns.

tokens.name: margin-mobile
tokens.usage: Outer margin at 402, 4 columns.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Column gutter at every breakpoint.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything poster-like: buttons, frames, cards, screens.

tokens.name: radius-ui
tokens.usage: Only inside interface chrome: discipline tags, the ASK key.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Rare: things that talk (a chip or tooltip, if one returns). The sound toggle is a bare waveform, not a pill.

tokens.name: glow-yellow
tokens.usage: Primary button and active progress at rest.

tokens.name: glow-yellow-hot
tokens.usage: Primary button hover: the light gets hotter, nothing moves.

tokens.name: glow-orange
tokens.usage: Reserved: an orange glow for ROB-092's notes on dark. Not used by the sound toggle.

tokens.name: glow-red
tokens.usage: The CONTACT title and the red record dot.

tokens.name: cast-paper
tokens.usage: ROB-092's soft shadow on the About cream wall (light top-left, falls down-right). The only cast shadow on that page.

tokens.name: screen-spill
tokens.usage: The light a playing screen throws on the page around it.

tokens.name: grain
tokens.usage: Film grain overlay on dark scenes (0.05 on paper).

tokens.name: vignette
tokens.usage: Edge darkening at the corners.

tokens.name: secondary-fill
tokens.usage: Cream over dark for the Secondary button (0.18 on hover).

tokens.name: crowd
tokens.usage: Max visibility of the Projects audience: blurred, darkened, lit only by the trailer, never a subject.
